bio.text: Tripp Hutchinson is an independent candidate for Idaho's 2nd Congressional District in 2026, running against Republican U.S. Rep. Mike Simpson.
He has served on the Ketchum City Council since 2024.
According to his campaign website, he was born and raised in Idaho.

sources.title: Ketchum councilman announces run for Congress
